findings.claim: The generated resolver remains undecorated. The change adds ExcludeFromCodeCoverage to the enum, object, string-key, and union formatter templates, but not to ResolverTemplate, so a [GeneratedMessagePackResolver] still produces a resolver class without the attribute. This violates the requirement that all generated code, explicitly including resolvers in the discussion, be decorated.

receipt_plan.detail: Run ResolverCodeCoverageReceiptTests.ResolverIsDecoratedWithExcludeFromCodeCoverage: generate output for a [GeneratedMessagePackResolver] partial class, locate its generated source, and assert that its declaration has global::System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverage. The assertion fails on this change because only the formatter templates were modified.
